name: Basicplanexecution Pattern
description: The basic plans execution content ontology design pattern represents the execution of a plan and the entity that participate in such an execution. This CP is the composition of other CPs: situation and region. Furthermore, it expands such CPs with ontology elements that are partial clones of elements from the DOCLE Ultra Lite and the Plans Lite ontologies.
competency_questions: Which actions make up a given run of a plan, and which run does a particular action belong to?; Who was involved in a given run of a plan, and which runs has a given person been involved in?; Which objects took part in a particular action, and in which actions has a given object taken part?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
